name: stats
description: Word statistics for a note: counts, reading time, top words. Rust, because it is one CPU pass over user text with no I/O.

capabilities.name: text_stats
capabilities.description: Word count, unique words, reading minutes at 200 words a minute, and the most frequent words of a text.
capabilities.rules: text up to 100000 characters; top (default 5, at most 50) caps topWords.
